description: Read-only investigator. Searches the workspace and answers with file:line citations. Delegate a search here to pay one answer instead of a whole investigation.
name: explore

description: Hands a task to a Claude Code session and sees it through to a report: it picks or starts the session (in a git worktree of its own for code changes), briefs it, waits out each of its turns, nudges it on, and stops when the work is done or a person must decide. Give it the task as you would a colleague — a bead id, what done looks like, a model or claude CLI options if you want them, a session id to continue one. By default it does not publish: its answer ends with what was committed (commits, files) and the exact commands to push the branch, open the pull request and clean up the worktree — yours to run. Only when your task explicitly says to push or open a PR does the Claude Code session do it — add "and clean up the worktree" to have the worktree and local branch removed once published; it never merges. It asks no permission to publish. Takes minutes to hours.
name: claude

description: Hands a task to a Codex session and sees it through to a report: it picks or starts the session (in a git worktree of its own for code changes), briefs it, waits out each of its turns, nudges it on, and stops when the work is done or a person must decide. Give it the task as you would a colleague — a bead id, what done looks like, a model or codex CLI options if you want them, a thread id to continue a session. A Codex session cannot commit or publish in its sandbox: its changes are committed for it on its branch, and its answer ends with the commits and the exact commands to push the branch, open the pull request and clean up the worktree — yours to run. Takes minutes to hours.
name: codex

description: Changes ONE file safely: probes it, writes once, verifies the diff, and rolls back the moment a check fails. Delegate a specific edit here rather than spending your own turn on the probe-and-verify discipline. Refuses a dirty file, and refuses a request spanning several files.
name: edit

description: Prepares this project for brainyard: checks the tools brainyard relies on (git, bd, tmux, claude, gh, codex) and says how to install the missing ones; writes AGENTS.md and a CLAUDE.md that imports it, keeping any text already there; sets up beads with bd; drafts the project's section of AGENTS.md from the repository. Say "check" to only report. Installs a tool only when asked to, and only after the person says yes.
name: init

description: Writes a plan only after confirming it has enough to write one, then grades what it wrote against a rubric. Delegate the thinking-before-acting here; it answers NEED with a single question, or REFUSE when the request wants an edit or a search rather than a plan.
name: plan

description: byj's main agent: every tool, no persona
name: default
